items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: Walter Page and myself played with Hazel Scott.

ctx.x: Did you use another girl vocalist after her?

After her Buck Clayton had 25 girls and I had 25 girls to see who was going to come in Basie's band. Who came in the band? Helen Humes, 1938, July. When we opened there we were supposed to have Rose Murphy play intermission piano, and Hazel Scott was down the street at the Hickory House on a bicycle with bobby socks on. I went down the street and got Hazel Scott coming in with a skirt and a whosis to come in and sit and Walter Page and myself played with Hazel Scott.
What's a whosis, Jo? We got to explain that to the people.
